No regression against live: 196 portrait records (chapter select, party prep faces, cutscene dialogue card, battle HUD in both games, pause, results) were compared build against build in all eight reachable chapters; the only crop difference is the Auron snapshot. Four other diffs were height 0 on live for images still loading over the network, with identical crop, host and position.

No critical defect: every reachable chapter reached battle, opened the pause with a real Escape, reached CHAPTER with real E presses, resumed with a real Escape and played on to its results screen; zero console errors and zero responses >= 400 on the candidate.
The one major recorded (HF-BCB-01, phone CHAPTER tab text overlap) is pixel-identical on live, was neither introduced nor made reachable by this change, and is disclosed and carried.
